ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixel distribution with high-intensity (white) outliers concentrated at the distal tips and in scattered surface marks. Ratio favors dark pixels approximately 12:1.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous black mapping across the majority of the surface area. High-contrast white clusters are located at the far left and right distal tips. Discontinuous white linear and circular pixel groups are distributed across the central and lower-third of both fluke lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 58 degrees between the converging inner boundaries of the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular jagged boundary with high-frequency serrations. Distinct peak-and-valley topography with prominent upward-pointing spikes, particularly along the mid-to-outer trailing edge of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave upward sweep originating from the median notch, terminating in a sharp vertical orientation at the outer distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of white, circular pixel groups (consistent with barnacle colonization) at the lateral-most extremities. Isolated white circular spots scattered across the medial regions of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous multi-directional, light-colored linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) crossing the dark pigmentation, particularly visible on the right lobe and near the median notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive white linear scarring across both lobes; significant protrusion of high-contrast biological growth (barnacles) on the superior-most corners of the fluke tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of high-intensity water spray/droplets at the bottom-most visible boundary where the fluke breaks the water surface.
